paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.05 as of 2026-09-14, with a change of -8.18% from the prior close and -17.75% over a window of 20 sessions. There have been no new news headlines in the last 24 hours.

A recent news headline from Stock Titan on 2026-09-11 reported that the largest Fermi shareholder group is pressing for a deal review, proposing to hire an independent bank to weigh sale or recap options and easing voting and REIT limits. This group owns about 22% of Fermi.

There have been various SEC filings, including 3 Form 4 filings, with the most recent ones dated 2026-08-27 and 2026-08-18, reporting insider transactions. Additionally, there was a Form 8-K filing on 2026-08-31, which scheduled the first annual meeting of stockholders for October 30, 2026.
